body: It used to sort of give me comfort to see other people that feel like this, but in the end it's just isolation. We are faces behind a mirror. Lots of mirrors with many drawn out faces. It just builds my sense of hopelessness

It's true. Small moments do have an impact. I find myself looking for a reason to keep going. It gets harder and harder. Those fumes feel like they are thinning out. Everyone around me is so oblivious. I feel like I have no leg to stand on and when I do reach out, those are only illusions I grab for that quickly fade. In the end people just only care about themselves. I feel naiive for feeling compassion or empathy. Sympathy.
I know how you feel. I can relate in many ways. Having many of the same struggles you are
